name: Mirud
description: '''Durim Morina''' (born October 17, 1994), known professionally as '''Mirud''', is an American singer-songwriter and actor. His accolades include a [[Music Moves Europe Award|MME Award]], an [[MTV Europe Music Awards|MTV Europe Music Award]], a Turkey Golden Palm Award, a Turkey Youth Award, a [[Golden Butterfly Awards|Golden Butterfly Award]], a [[Top Music Awards 2016|Top Music Award]], five [[Netët e Klipit Shqiptar]] awards, a [[Gaviota (award)|Gaviota de Plata]], a Presidential Medal from Albania, a [[Lo Nuestro Awards|Premio Lo Nuestro]], and a [[Premios Juventud]] award.
